uncomfortable.oewn-00480005-a.label: neutral

family.axis: faint bodily unease → outright physical misery

uncomfortable.oewn-00480005-a.tone: The plain cover term, working equally for the thing that gives the discomfort and the body that feels it, which is what keeps it so flat.

bad.oewn-00480301-s.label: negative

family.axis: faint bodily unease → outright physical misery

bad.oewn-00480301-s.tone: Blunt and unspecific about the body feeling wrong, naming neither the site nor the sharpness of what is felt.

tough.oewn-00480301-s.label: negative

family.axis: faint bodily unease → outright physical misery

tough.oewn-00480301-s.tone: The colloquial counterpart to *bad*, looser and more offhand about the same felt discomfort.

tough.oewn-00750063-s.label: neutral

family.axis: difficulty framed as a stretch worth making → difficulty framed as a predicament no one would want

tough.oewn-00750063-s.tone: Informal and almost respectful of the difficulty - it sizes up the mental demand as something to be taken on and says nothing against it.

comfortless.oewn-00480580-s.label: negative

family.axis: faint bodily unease → outright physical misery

comfortless.oewn-00480580-s.tone: States a lack rather than a hurt — the bleakness sits in what is missing, which makes it colder than *uncomfortable*.

irritating.oewn-00480675-s.label: negative

family.axis: faint bodily unease → outright physical misery

irritating.oewn-00480675-s.tone: Points at discomfort that nags and chafes, a lower-grade complaint than *painful* though the two name the same effect.

painful.oewn-00480675-s.label: negative

family.axis: faint bodily unease → outright physical misery

painful.oewn-00480675-s.tone: The heavier word for that same effect, putting the discomfort on the scale of hurt rather than annoyance.

miserable.oewn-00480862-s.label: negative

family.axis: faint bodily unease → outright physical misery

miserable.oewn-00480862-s.tone: Gathers the discomfort into a whole bodily condition instead of a single sensation, so it reads as total rather than local.

wretched.oewn-00480862-s.label: negative

family.axis: faint bodily unease → outright physical misery

wretched.oewn-00480862-s.tone: A degree past *miserable* on the same misery — abject, with no dignity left to the body it describes.

uneasy.oewn-00481063-s.label: negative

family.axis: faint bodily unease → outright physical misery

uneasy.oewn-00481063-s.tone: The faintest of these: a bodily unsettledness that has not hardened into pain, more a hint than a hurt.

warm.oewn-00481182-s.label: neutral

family.axis: faint bodily unease → outright physical misery

warm.oewn-00481182-s.tone: Locates the discomfort in looming danger or trouble rather than in the flesh, and its mildness is exactly what makes it sound like a warning.

broad-minded.oewn-00287444-a.label: positive

family.axis: quiet readiness to hear a new idea → outright refusal of authority and dogma

broad-minded.oewn-00287444-a.tone: Warm, unhedged praise for a settled disposition, crediting respect for the differing view rather than the bare patience *tolerant* stops at.

broad.oewn-00287703-s.label: positive

family.axis: quiet readiness to hear a new idea → outright refusal of authority and dogma

broad.oewn-00287703-s.tone: Understated almost to neutrality — the same approval as *broad-minded* with the force stripped out of it.

large-minded.oewn-00287703-s.label: positive

family.axis: quiet readiness to hear a new idea → outright refusal of authority and dogma

large-minded.oewn-00287703-s.tone: Sounds a note of magnanimity, as though the openness were generosity of spirit and not merely fairness.

liberal.oewn-00287703-s.label: positive

family.axis: quiet readiness to hear a new idea → outright refusal of authority and dogma

liberal.oewn-00287703-s.tone: The most expansive term here, praising openness as a governing principle rather than a reaction to any particular view.

tolerant.oewn-00287703-s.label: positive

family.axis: quiet readiness to hear a new idea → outright refusal of authority and dogma

tolerant.oewn-00287703-s.tone: The coolest praise in the set — it credits forbearance, granting a view room instead of welcoming it.

catholic.oewn-00287994-s.label: positive

family.axis: quiet readiness to hear a new idea → outright refusal of authority and dogma

catholic.oewn-00287994-s.tone: Formal and elevated, praising a sweep wide enough that no narrow attachment survives it.

free-thinking.oewn-00288141-s.label: positive

family.axis: quiet readiness to hear a new idea → outright refusal of authority and dogma

free-thinking.oewn-00288141-s.tone: Praise with defiance in it — the openness is a refusal of dogma, not the mild receptiveness of *open-minded*.

latitudinarian.oewn-00288141-s.label: neutral

family.axis: quiet readiness to hear a new idea → outright refusal of authority and dogma

latitudinarian.oewn-00288141-s.tone: Bookish and clinical, naming the position where *free-thinking* cheers for it.

undogmatic.oewn-00288141-s.label: positive

family.axis: quiet readiness to hear a new idea → outright refusal of authority and dogma

undogmatic.oewn-00288141-s.tone: Defined by what it withholds, measuring out its approval as an absence of rigidity rather than any positive warmth.

undogmatical.oewn-00288141-s.label: positive

family.axis: quiet readiness to hear a new idea → outright refusal of authority and dogma

undogmatical.oewn-00288141-s.tone: The longer, stiffer twin of *undogmatic*, its extra syllable pulling it further from anything conversational.

open-minded.oewn-00288364-s.label: positive

family.axis: quiet readiness to hear a new idea → outright refusal of authority and dogma

open-minded.oewn-00288364-s.tone: Plain and unpretentious, asking no more than a willingness to hear the new idea out.

fair.oewn-00959321-a.label: positive

family.axis: neutral naming of rules against unfair dealing → emphatic praise for dealing fairly

fair.oewn-00959321-a.tone: Plain, unarguable approval - it certifies that no favoritism or deception got in, without the weight of principle *just* carries.

just.oewn-00959321-a.label: positive

family.axis: neutral naming of rules against unfair dealing → emphatic praise for dealing fairly

just.oewn-00959321-a.tone: Heavier than *fair* - the same absence of bias, but weighted as a standard rightly upheld rather than a condition merely met.

antimonopoly.oewn-00959758-s.label: neutral

family.axis: neutral naming of rules against unfair dealing → emphatic praise for dealing fairly

antimonopoly.oewn-00959758-s.tone: Purely classificatory - it says what a law or regulation is built to protect trade from, and commends no one.

antitrust.oewn-00959758-s.label: neutral

family.axis: neutral naming of rules against unfair dealing → emphatic praise for dealing fairly

antitrust.oewn-00959758-s.tone: Technical and as neutral as *antimonopoly*, marking a regulation's protective purpose rather than approving anybody's conduct.

clean.oewn-00959923-s.label: positive

family.axis: neutral naming of rules against unfair dealing → emphatic praise for dealing fairly

clean.oewn-00959923-s.tone: Approves by negation - nothing foul in the play - where *sportsmanlike* names the virtue outright.

clean.oewn-01920489-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare report that nothing limits it → emphatic refusal to admit any reservation or exception

clean.oewn-01920489-s.tone: Faintly approving — freedom from qualifications felt as tidiness, nothing left clinging, where *unqualified* only records that nothing is attached.

sporting.oewn-00959923-s.label: positive

family.axis: neutral naming of rules against unfair dealing → emphatic praise for dealing fairly

sporting.oewn-00959923-s.tone: Warmer and easier than *clean*, crediting fair play as a spirit brought to the contest rather than a rule left unbroken.

sporty.oewn-00959923-s.label: positive

family.axis: neutral naming of rules against unfair dealing → emphatic praise for dealing fairly

sporty.oewn-00959923-s.tone: The most casual of these, informal and light, granting the same approval with none of *sportsmanlike*'s weight.

sportsmanlike.oewn-00959923-s.label: positive

family.axis: neutral naming of rules against unfair dealing → emphatic praise for dealing fairly

sportsmanlike.oewn-00959923-s.tone: The formal member - it measures conduct against a named standard of sportsmanship instead of merely reporting, as *clean* does, that nothing foul happened.

fair-minded.oewn-00960166-s.label: positive

family.axis: neutral naming of rules against unfair dealing → emphatic praise for dealing fairly

fair-minded.oewn-00960166-s.tone: Praises a settled cast of mind rather than a single dealing - the impartiality is lodged in the person.

fair-and-square.oewn-00960289-s.label: positive

family.axis: neutral naming of rules against unfair dealing → emphatic praise for dealing fairly

fair-and-square.oewn-00960289-s.tone: The emphatic one - its doubled phrasing insists there is nothing left to question, where *just* simply states that the standard was met.

trustworthy.oewn-02473921-a.label: positive

family.axis: cool certification that something checks out -> warm, whole-character avowal of faith in it

trustworthy.oewn-02473921-a.tone: The plain, unhedged verdict of the family - approval stated flatly, with no warmth or ceremony added to it.

trusty.oewn-02473921-a.label: positive

family.axis: cool certification that something checks out -> warm, whole-character avowal of faith in it

trusty.oewn-02473921-a.tone: Approving with a homely, affectionate warmth that *trustworthy* keeps out, and a faint pat on the head with it.

authentic.oewn-02474343-s.label: positive

family.axis: cool certification that something checks out -> warm, whole-character avowal of faith in it

authentic.oewn-02474343-s.tone: The belief is earned by checking out against the facts, so the praise is for genuineness rather than for any goodwill.

reliable.oewn-02474343-s.label: positive

family.axis: cool certification that something checks out -> warm, whole-character avowal of faith in it

reliable.oewn-02474343-s.tone: Sober and unexcited - it credits a thing with holding up under scrutiny and claims nothing more stirring than that.

creditworthy.oewn-02474578-s.label: positive

family.axis: cool certification that something checks out -> warm, whole-character avowal of faith in it

creditworthy.oewn-02474578-s.tone: Technical and bloodless, certifying a bar cleared rather than praising anything about the one who cleared it.

responsible.oewn-02474578-s.label: positive

family.axis: cool certification that something checks out -> warm, whole-character avowal of faith in it

responsible.oewn-02474578-s.tone: A quiet nod at financial standing, softer and less procedural-sounding than *creditworthy* though it settles the same question.

dependable.oewn-02474747-s.label: positive

family.axis: cool certification that something checks out -> warm, whole-character avowal of faith in it

dependable.oewn-02474747-s.tone: Praise for weight-bearing steadiness - it promises the thing will hold, where *authentic* only says it is what it claims.

honest.oewn-02474747-s.label: positive

family.axis: cool certification that something checks out -> warm, whole-character avowal of faith in it

honest.oewn-02474747-s.tone: Warmer and broader than *dependable*, resting the approval on the whole character rather than on any record of performance.

true.oewn-02474747-s.label: positive

family.axis: cool certification that something checks out -> warm, whole-character avowal of faith in it

true.oewn-02474747-s.tone: Elevated and absolute - constancy raised to a virtue, with a solemn ring that *dependable* never reaches for.

fiducial.oewn-02475134-s.label: neutral

family.axis: cool certification that something checks out -> warm, whole-character avowal of faith in it

fiducial.oewn-02475134-s.tone: Technical and classifying - it marks a thing as resting on trust without any opinion on whether that trust is deserved.

sure.oewn-02475203-s.label: positive

family.axis: cool certification that something checks out -> warm, whole-character avowal of faith in it

sure.oewn-02475203-s.tone: Blunt and unqualified, the whole verdict compressed into one syllable that leaves no room for hedging.

trusted.oewn-02475203-s.label: positive

family.axis: cool certification that something checks out -> warm, whole-character avowal of faith in it

trusted.oewn-02475203-s.tone: The participle makes the standing something conferred, where *sure* names a quality the person carries on their own.

overt.oewn-01709214-a.label: neutral

family.axis: merely observable → unconcealed to the point of effrontery

overt.oewn-01709214-a.tone: Flat and formal - it marks a thing as out where it can be seen and stops there, with none of the affront *barefaced* adds.

open.oewn-01709214-a.label: neutral

family.axis: merely observable → unconcealed to the point of effrontery

open.oewn-01709214-a.tone: The plain everyday word for the same state, weightless where *overt* sounds like a term of art.

bald.oewn-01709541-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely observable → unconcealed to the point of effrontery

bald.oewn-01709541-s.tone: Blunt - concealment is not just absent but conspicuously unattempted, and the missing softening reads as harshness.

barefaced.oewn-01709541-s.label: negative

family.axis: merely observable → unconcealed to the point of effrontery

barefaced.oewn-01709541-s.tone: Accusatory where *bald* is merely blunt - the failure to conceal registers as nerve, something the doer should have been ashamed to show.

naked.oewn-01709648-s.label: neutral

family.axis: merely observable → unconcealed to the point of effrontery

naked.oewn-01709648-s.tone: Stark - nothing added and nothing subtracted, so the thing stands in its own unsoftened proportions.

raw.oewn-01709648-s.label: neutral

family.axis: merely observable → unconcealed to the point of effrontery

raw.oewn-01709648-s.tone: Coarser-grained than *naked* - unworked rather than merely stripped, with the roughness of the thing left on it.

undisguised.oewn-01709871-s.label: neutral

family.axis: merely observable → unconcealed to the point of effrontery

undisguised.oewn-01709871-s.tone: Names concealment in order to deny it, so what is plain to see carries the sense of something that could have been hidden and was not.

visible.oewn-01709966-s.label: neutral

family.axis: merely observable → unconcealed to the point of effrontery

visible.oewn-01709966-s.tone: Purely descriptive and the mildest of the set - it reports what the eye catches, without implying anything was ever kept back.

unqualified.oewn-01920096-a.label: neutral

family.axis: bare report that nothing limits it → emphatic refusal to admit any reservation or exception

unqualified.oewn-01920096-a.tone: The bare statement of the case — nothing limits or restricts the thing — with none of the insistence *categorical* puts behind it.

categoric.oewn-01920312-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare report that nothing limits it → emphatic refusal to admit any reservation or exception

categoric.oewn-01920312-s.tone: Formal and clipped, it shuts the door on reservations like a ruling handed down, where *unqualified* merely reports that there are none.

categorical.oewn-01920312-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare report that nothing limits it → emphatic refusal to admit any reservation or exception

categorical.oewn-01920312-s.tone: The unclipped form of *categoric*, and the extra syllable lands as extra weight: reservations are not merely absent but refused.

flat.oewn-01920312-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare report that nothing limits it → emphatic refusal to admit any reservation or exception

flat.oewn-01920312-s.tone: Blunt and monosyllabic — the refusal of reservations delivered as a door shutting, where *categorical* delivers it as a pronouncement.

unconditional.oewn-01920312-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare report that nothing limits it → emphatic refusal to admit any reservation or exception

unconditional.oewn-01920312-s.tone: Formal and absolute, it presents the missing reservations as terms deliberately not imposed rather than as *flat*'s curt refusal to entertain them.

clear.oewn-01920489-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare report that nothing limits it → emphatic refusal to admit any reservation or exception

clear.oewn-01920489-s.tone: The same freedom as *clean*, but as an unobstructed way through rather than a tidy finish: nothing in the way rather than nothing left over.

outright.oewn-01920788-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare report that nothing limits it → emphatic refusal to admit any reservation or exception

outright.oewn-01920788-s.tone: Emphatic and forceful, it presses the thing all the way through with no exception admitted, well past *unqualified*'s bare report.

straight-out.oewn-01920788-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare report that nothing limits it → emphatic refusal to admit any reservation or exception

straight-out.oewn-01920788-s.tone: Informal and plain-spoken, it admits no reservation or exception exactly as *outright* does, but without the ceremony.

unlimited.oewn-01920788-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare report that nothing limits it → emphatic refusal to admit any reservation or exception

unlimited.oewn-01920788-s.tone: Reads as sheer extent — nothing bounds the thing — where *outright* reads as manner, nothing qualifying it.

inferior.oewn-02348283-a.label: negative

family.axis: neutral placement on a scale of rank → dismissive verdict of standing beneath others

inferior.oewn-02348283-a.tone: The bare comparative of the set: it grades a thing below others and lets the ranking itself carry the sting, where *humble* names the same position without grading it.

humble.oewn-02348528-s.label: neutral

family.axis: neutral placement on a scale of rank → dismissive verdict of standing beneath others

humble.oewn-02348528-s.tone: Names low station with a quiet grace, so the lowness reads as unpretending rather than deficient.

low.oewn-02348528-s.label: negative

family.axis: neutral placement on a scale of rank → dismissive verdict of standing beneath others

low.oewn-02348528-s.tone: The blunt monosyllable for that station, stating the bottom position flatly and with none of the softening in *humble*.

lowly.oewn-02348528-s.label: neutral

family.axis: neutral placement on a scale of rank → dismissive verdict of standing beneath others

lowly.oewn-02348528-s.tone: Adds a meek, faintly literary air to the low position, so it sounds borne rather than merely recorded.

modest.oewn-02348528-s.label: neutral

family.axis: neutral placement on a scale of rank → dismissive verdict of standing beneath others

modest.oewn-02348528-s.tone: The tactful word for the same lowness, declining to call it poor and leaving the thing its dignity.

small.oewn-02348528-s.label: negative

family.axis: neutral placement on a scale of rank → dismissive verdict of standing beneath others

small.oewn-02348528-s.tone: Shrinks rather than ranks, so the low quality registers as insignificance instead of a place on a ladder.

indifferent.oewn-02348780-s.label: negative

family.axis: neutral placement on a scale of rank → dismissive verdict of standing beneath others

indifferent.oewn-02348780-s.tone: Damns by withholding: it refuses praise rather than delivering a charge, and the refusal is the verdict.

low-level.oewn-02348948-s.label: neutral

family.axis: neutral placement on a scale of rank → dismissive verdict of standing beneath others

low-level.oewn-02348948-s.tone: Purely positional, marking a rung on a scale of rank without judging the worth of whatever stands there.

middle-level.oewn-02349084-s.label: neutral

family.axis: neutral placement on a scale of rank → dismissive verdict of standing beneath others

middle-level.oewn-02349084-s.tone: A coordinate rather than a verdict, fixing a point between top and bottom and claiming nothing about quality.

outclassed.oewn-02349202-s.label: negative

family.axis: neutral placement on a scale of rank → dismissive verdict of standing beneath others

outclassed.oewn-02349202-s.tone: The strongest of the set: the low standing is the outcome of a contest already decisively lost, so the word carries the humiliation of the comparison.

intellectual.oewn-01335338-a.label: neutral

family.axis: bare description of mental engagement → approving claim of cultivation

intellectual.oewn-01335338-a.tone: The plain term of the family - it names the faculty being engaged and passes no verdict on it.

intellectual.oewn-01784888-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plain and broad, the mind is involved → technical and exact, the mind rather than the body is the source

intellectual.oewn-01784888-s.tone: Points at the mind as the thing engaged, in a register more elevated than *mental* - a label for the domain rather than a verdict on the work done in it.

highbrow.oewn-01335859-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare description of mental engagement → approving claim of cultivation

highbrow.oewn-01335859-s.tone: Makes the cultivation conspicuous, so the compliment carries an edge *intellectual* does not.

highbrowed.oewn-01335859-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare description of mental engagement → approving claim of cultivation

highbrowed.oewn-01335859-s.tone: The same claim to high cultivation as *highbrow*, but the participial form sits heavier and stiffer.

rational.oewn-01336070-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare description of mental engagement → approving claim of cultivation

rational.oewn-01336070-s.tone: Positional rather than approving - it places the source of the thinking in the intellect as against experience.

rational.oewn-01931771-a.label: positive

family.axis: bare possession of the reasoning faculty → reason praised as sound judgment

rational.oewn-01931771-a.tone: Approves by pointing at the grounds - the thing rests on reason - where *reasonable* praises the quality of the judgment actually reached.

rational.oewn-01784888-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plain and broad, the mind is involved → technical and exact, the mind rather than the body is the source

rational.oewn-01784888-s.tone: Points at the mind as the faculty at work rather than at the soundness of what it produces, making it a label and not a verdict.

reflective.oewn-01336283-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare description of mental engagement → approving claim of cultivation

reflective.oewn-01336283-s.tone: Quieter and warmer than *intellectual* - a mind given over to its own concerns rather than one showing power.

good.oewn-01336429-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare description of mental engagement → approving claim of cultivation

good.oewn-01336429-s.tone: The barest approval here - it grants appeal to the mind without characterizing that appeal at all.

good.oewn-00454916-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare nearness or resemblance → settled, felt intimacy

good.oewn-00454916-s.tone: Plain and understated for the same close relationship - it vouches for the bond rather than professing feeling as *dear* does.

good.oewn-01813594-s.label: positive

family.axis: faint, matter-of-fact approval → superlative delight

good.oewn-01813594-s.tone: All-purpose and colourless - it grants no more than the capacity to please, where *pleasing* reports pleasure actually given.

good.oewn-00065107-s.label: positive

family.axis: advantage merely registered → good actively credited

good.oewn-00065107-s.tone: The same claim as *beneficial* stripped of its formality, asserting the benefit flatly instead of arguing for it.

serious.oewn-01336429-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare description of mental engagement → approving claim of cultivation

serious.oewn-01336429-s.tone: Weightier than *good* for the same appeal to the mind, casting it as demanding rather than merely worth having.

sophisticated.oewn-01336561-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare description of mental engagement → approving claim of cultivation

sophisticated.oewn-01336561-s.tone: The warmest of these - it treats appeal to the intellect as refinement rather than plain substance.

coherent.oewn-01932107-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare possession of the reasoning faculty → reason praised as sound judgment

coherent.oewn-01932107-s.tone: Praise at its lowest setting: the thought holds together and comes out clear, a floor cleared rather than the brightness *lucid* claims.

logical.oewn-01932107-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare possession of the reasoning faculty → reason praised as sound judgment

logical.oewn-01932107-s.tone: Dry, near-technical commendation - the clear consistent thinking treated as something that works by rule, with none of *lucid*'s warmth.

lucid.oewn-01932107-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare possession of the reasoning faculty → reason praised as sound judgment

lucid.oewn-01932107-s.tone: The warmest of the three: the same clear consistent thinking praised as brightness, where *coherent* merely reports that it hangs together.

demythologized.oewn-01932378-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare possession of the reasoning faculty → reason praised as sound judgment

demythologized.oewn-01932378-s.tone: Flatly descriptive - records that the mythical element is gone without approving or regretting its removal.

demythologised.oewn-01932378-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare possession of the reasoning faculty → reason praised as sound judgment

demythologised.oewn-01932378-s.tone: Carries no more judgment than *demythologized*: the stripping of myth is stated, not celebrated or mourned.

intelligent.oewn-01932488-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare possession of the reasoning faculty → reason praised as sound judgment

intelligent.oewn-01932488-s.tone: Turns the bare endowment into a compliment, where *reasoning* and *thinking* only register that the capacity is there.

reasoning.oewn-01932488-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare possession of the reasoning faculty → reason praised as sound judgment

reasoning.oewn-01932488-s.tone: Purely descriptive - states that the faculty is present and stops, extending none of the credit *intelligent* does for it.

thinking.oewn-01932488-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare possession of the reasoning faculty → reason praised as sound judgment

thinking.oewn-01932488-s.tone: Neutral in the way *reasoning* is, marking the capacity as a plain attribute rather than a merit.

reasonable.oewn-01932628-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare possession of the reasoning faculty → reason praised as sound judgment

reasonable.oewn-01932628-s.tone: Solid approval of judgment exercised well, going past *rational*'s weaker claim that reason was involved at all.

sane.oewn-01932628-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare possession of the reasoning faculty → reason praised as sound judgment

sane.oewn-01932628-s.tone: The same sound judgment, but pitched as the bar a mind must clear rather than a distinction it earns, which gives it a weight *reasonable* has not.

mental.oewn-01784531-a.label: neutral

family.axis: plain and broad, the mind is involved → technical and exact, the mind rather than the body is the source

mental.oewn-01784531-a.tone: The plainest of these, taking in any process the mind performs without the technical precision *psychological* carries.

noetic.oewn-01784888-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plain and broad, the mind is involved → technical and exact, the mind rather than the body is the source

noetic.oewn-01784888-s.tone: The most abstract and learned of the set, naming mind-work in a lofty register that *mental* keeps flat.

moral.oewn-01785141-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plain and broad, the mind is involved → technical and exact, the mind rather than the body is the source

moral.oewn-01785141-s.tone: Names not the mind itself but the kind of effect that lands there, real in force with nothing tangible behind it.

psychic.oewn-01785285-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plain and broad, the mind is involved → technical and exact, the mind rather than the body is the source

psychic.oewn-01785285-s.tone: Reaches in both directions at once, covering what the mind acts on and what acts on the mind, where *psychogenic* narrows to where a thing began.

psychical.oewn-01785285-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plain and broad, the mind is involved → technical and exact, the mind rather than the body is the source

psychical.oewn-01785285-s.tone: The heavier, more formal twin of *psychic*, identical in what it covers and stiffer in the saying.

psychogenic.oewn-01785482-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plain and broad, the mind is involved → technical and exact, the mind rather than the body is the source

psychogenic.oewn-01785482-s.tone: Technical and exact about causation, placing the starting point in the mind rather than the body instead of merely sorting by nature.

psychological.oewn-01785621-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plain and broad, the mind is involved → technical and exact, the mind rather than the body is the source

psychological.oewn-01785621-s.tone: The workaday technical term here, sorting a thing by what it is in nature rather than, as *psychogenic* does, by where it came from.

international.oewn-01572768-a.label: neutral

family.axis: involving as few as two nations → covering the whole earth or rising above national boundaries

international.oewn-01572768-a.tone: Neutral and minimal in its demand — two nations are enough to satisfy it, where *global* asks for the whole earth.

global.oewn-01573077-s.label: neutral

family.axis: involving as few as two nations → covering the whole earth or rising above national boundaries

global.oewn-01573077-s.tone: The unmarked word for whole-earth extent, and the one that sets that extent against the narrow and the provincial.

planetary.oewn-01573077-s.label: neutral

family.axis: involving as few as two nations → covering the whole earth or rising above national boundaries

planetary.oewn-01573077-s.tone: Covers the same whole-earth extent as *global* but with a grander, more astronomical ring to it.

world.oewn-01573077-s.label: neutral

family.axis: involving as few as two nations → covering the whole earth or rising above national boundaries

world.oewn-01573077-s.tone: A bare noun pressed into adjective duty, flat and workmanlike where *global* sounds considered.

worldwide.oewn-01573077-s.label: neutral

family.axis: involving as few as two nations → covering the whole earth or rising above national boundaries

worldwide.oewn-01573077-s.tone: Puts the weight on reach stretching across the earth rather than on the earth as a single whole, which *global* implies.

world-wide.oewn-01573077-s.label: neutral

family.axis: involving as few as two nations → covering the whole earth or rising above national boundaries

world-wide.oewn-01573077-s.tone: The hyphenated form of *worldwide*, identical in force and a shade more deliberate on the page.

internationalist.oewn-01573395-s.label: neutral

family.axis: involving as few as two nations → covering the whole earth or rising above national boundaries

internationalist.oewn-01573395-s.tone: Names a commitment rather than an extent — it says where someone stands, not how far something reaches, as *international* does.

internationalistic.oewn-01573395-s.label: neutral

family.axis: involving as few as two nations → covering the whole earth or rising above national boundaries

internationalistic.oewn-01573395-s.tone: The longer form, stiffer and more label-like than *internationalist* without adding to the stance it names.

multinational.oewn-01573559-s.label: neutral

family.axis: involving as few as two nations → covering the whole earth or rising above national boundaries

multinational.oewn-01573559-s.tone: Plain and countable — several nations or nationalities added together, where *international* needs only a relation between two.

transnational.oewn-01573559-s.label: neutral

family.axis: involving as few as two nations → covering the whole earth or rising above national boundaries

transnational.oewn-01573559-s.tone: Frames the same several-nation range as crossing the lines rather than summing them up, as *multinational* does.

supranational.oewn-01573759-s.label: neutral

family.axis: involving as few as two nations → covering the whole earth or rising above national boundaries

supranational.oewn-01573759-s.tone: Sets the thing above national boundaries and interests rather than merely across them, a step beyond *transnational*.

confident.oewn-00339715-a.label: neutral

family.axis: confidence restored or plainly held → confidence carried past what warrants it

confident.oewn-00339715-a.tone: The plain baseline of the family, reporting that the assurance is there without passing any verdict on whether it is warranted.

assured.oewn-00340055-s.label: positive

family.axis: confidence restored or plainly held → confidence carried past what warrants it

assured.oewn-00340055-s.tone: Shifts from the inner state to the visible one, crediting a confidence you can see in the bearing where *confident* merely records it.

cocksure.oewn-00340186-s.label: negative

family.axis: confidence restored or plainly held → confidence carried past what warrants it

cocksure.oewn-00340186-s.tone: Jeering and informal - the excess is not diagnosed but mocked, a swagger the word refuses to take seriously beside the flat *overconfident*.

overconfident.oewn-00340186-s.label: negative

family.axis: confidence restored or plainly held → confidence carried past what warrants it

overconfident.oewn-00340186-s.tone: The straight clinical name for the fault, marking the confidence as more than warranted and leaving the derision to *cocksure*.

positive.oewn-00340186-s.label: negative

family.axis: confidence restored or plainly held → confidence carried past what warrants it

positive.oewn-00340186-s.tone: The mildest carrier of that same excess, an everyday word that lets the overreach register as a shrug rather than an accusation.

positive.oewn-00065384-s.label: positive

family.axis: advantage merely registered → good actively credited

positive.oewn-00065384-s.tone: Broad and unemphatic approval that places a thing on the good side without naming the advantage, where *beneficial* names it.

reassured.oewn-00340497-s.label: positive

family.axis: confidence restored or plainly held → confidence carried past what warrants it

reassured.oewn-00340497-s.tone: Confidence handed back rather than held all along - the settled calm of anxiety lifted, where the rest of the family says nothing about anything having been shaken.

self-assured.oewn-00340640-s.label: positive

family.axis: confidence restored or plainly held → confidence carried past what warrants it

self-assured.oewn-00340640-s.tone: Turns the poise inward onto one's own worth and lets it show as composure, steadier-sounding than the bare *confident*.

self-confident.oewn-00340640-s.label: positive

family.axis: confidence restored or plainly held → confidence carried past what warrants it

self-confident.oewn-00340640-s.tone: The plainest label for that same belief in one's own worth, stating it where *self-assured* leans on the outward steadiness.

nasty.oewn-01591485-a.label: negative

family.axis: offensive or unpleasant → actively malicious

nasty.oewn-01591485-a.tone: Condemns without naming the fault, covering plain offensiveness and shading into outright ill will, where *hateful* puts the malice at the centre.

awful.oewn-01591485-a.label: negative

family.axis: offensive or unpleasant → actively malicious

awful.oewn-01591485-a.tone: Absolute rather than pointed - the condemnation is total in degree where *nasty* keeps a needling edge.

dirty.oewn-01591882-s.label: negative

family.axis: offensive or unpleasant → actively malicious

dirty.oewn-01591882-s.tone: Contempt by way of defilement - it treats what it hits as unclean rather than merely offensive, a heavier verdict than *grotty*.

filthy.oewn-01591882-s.label: negative

family.axis: offensive or unpleasant → actively malicious

filthy.oewn-01591882-s.tone: The disgust in *dirty* pushed to its limit, vileness so thorough it lands as a moral verdict.

lousy.oewn-01591882-s.label: negative

family.axis: offensive or unpleasant → actively malicious

lousy.oewn-01591882-s.tone: Contempt thrown off casually - the despising is real but carries none of the weight that *filthy* brings to it.

grotty.oewn-01592051-s.label: negative

family.axis: offensive or unpleasant → actively malicious

grotty.oewn-01592051-s.tone: British and slangy, it registers offensiveness as squalid distaste rather than the moral condemnation in *filthy*.

hateful.oewn-01592194-s.label: negative

family.axis: offensive or unpleasant → actively malicious

hateful.oewn-01592194-s.tone: Makes ill will the whole of the charge, naming the malice itself where *nasty* only shades toward it.

mean.oewn-01592194-s.label: negative

family.axis: offensive or unpleasant → actively malicious

mean.oewn-01592194-s.tone: The plainest word for malice, stating the ill will flatly where *hateful* makes it sound monstrous.

satisfactory.oewn-02087716-a.label: positive

family.axis: barely tolerable sufficiency → complete, worry-dissolving satisfaction

satisfactory.oewn-02087716-a.tone: Approval delivered as a finding rather than a compliment — it certifies that satisfaction was given, where *fine* simply grants it.

adequate.oewn-02088076-s.label: neutral

family.axis: barely tolerable sufficiency → complete, worry-dissolving satisfaction

adequate.oewn-02088076-s.tone: Cool and measuring — it grants acceptability and stops there, withholding the warmth *fine* carries.

passable.oewn-02088076-s.label: neutral

family.axis: barely tolerable sufficiency → complete, worry-dissolving satisfaction

passable.oewn-02088076-s.tone: Acceptance with the bar still visible underneath it: the thing gets through, where *adequate* says it measures up.

fair_to_middling.oewn-02088076-s.label: neutral

family.axis: barely tolerable sufficiency → complete, worry-dissolving satisfaction

fair_to_middling.oewn-02088076-s.tone: A colloquial shrug whose own hedging spreads the verdict between fair and middling instead of landing on either.

tolerable.oewn-02088076-s.label: negative

family.axis: barely tolerable sufficiency → complete, worry-dissolving satisfaction

tolerable.oewn-02088076-s.tone: The most grudging of these acceptances, framing the acceptable thing as something borne, where *passable* at least lets it through clean.

all_right.oewn-02088253-s.label: positive

family.axis: barely tolerable sufficiency → complete, worry-dissolving satisfaction

all_right.oewn-02088253-s.tone: A plain all-clear — it reports that nothing is amiss rather than that anything is good, a smaller claim than *copacetic* makes.

fine.oewn-02088253-s.label: positive

family.axis: barely tolerable sufficiency → complete, worry-dissolving satisfaction

fine.oewn-02088253-s.tone: Brisk and unqualified: one syllable that closes the question of whether the thing will do, with none of *satisfactory*'s weighing.

ok.oewn-02088253-s.label: neutral

family.axis: barely tolerable sufficiency → complete, worry-dissolving satisfaction

ok.oewn-02088253-s.tone: The barest possible grant of sufficiency — two letters conceding the thing is in order, without a particle of the warmth in *fine*.

okay.oewn-02088253-s.label: neutral

family.axis: barely tolerable sufficiency → complete, worry-dissolving satisfaction

okay.oewn-02088253-s.tone: The spelled-out form, sitting in a sentence as a word rather than a mark, with the same flat sufficiency as *ok*.

hunky-dory.oewn-02088253-s.label: positive

family.axis: barely tolerable sufficiency → complete, worry-dissolving satisfaction

hunky-dory.oewn-02088253-s.tone: Breezy slang whose bounce overshoots the modest thing it reports — all is in order, announced as though it were a delight.

cool.oewn-02088253-s.label: positive

family.axis: barely tolerable sufficiency → complete, worry-dissolving satisfaction

cool.oewn-02088253-s.tone: Slangy assent that approves by declining to object; the ease is the point, where *fine* merely settles the matter.

alright.oewn-02088638-s.label: neutral

family.axis: barely tolerable sufficiency → complete, worry-dissolving satisfaction

alright.oewn-02088638-s.tone: The same untroubled sufficiency in a spelling flagged as nonstandard, and that flag is the whole of what separates it from *all right*.

comforting.oewn-02088709-s.label: positive

family.axis: barely tolerable sufficiency → complete, worry-dissolving satisfaction

comforting.oewn-02088709-s.tone: Warm and aimed at the worrier — it quiets a mind rather than removing what alarmed it, softer than the lift in *cheering*.

cheering.oewn-02088709-s.label: positive

family.axis: barely tolerable sufficiency → complete, worry-dissolving satisfaction

cheering.oewn-02088709-s.tone: Raises rather than soothes: it clears worry by lifting the spirits, where *comforting* clears it by settling them.

satisfying.oewn-02088709-s.label: positive

family.axis: barely tolerable sufficiency → complete, worry-dissolving satisfaction

satisfying.oewn-02088709-s.tone: Relief supplied by sufficiency itself — the worry lifts because the thing proves enough, where *comforting* works on the person instead.

copacetic.oewn-02088818-s.label: positive

family.axis: barely tolerable sufficiency → complete, worry-dissolving satisfaction

copacetic.oewn-02088818-s.tone: Slangy and total — it closes off every remaining objection, where *all right* reports only that none has surfaced.

close.oewn-00453543-a.label: neutral

family.axis: bare nearness or resemblance → settled, felt intimacy

close.oewn-00453543-a.tone: The plain measure of nearness in relevance or relationship, stating the proximity without the warmth or the suspicion the rest of the set add.

approximate.oewn-00453905-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare nearness or resemblance → settled, felt intimacy

approximate.oewn-00453905-s.tone: Measuring and cool - it rates a resemblance as very close while stopping short of calling it the same thing.

near.oewn-00453905-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare nearness or resemblance → settled, felt intimacy

near.oewn-00453905-s.tone: Blunter than *approximate* for the same degree of resemblance - it asserts the likeness flatly instead of hedging it.

boon.oewn-00454053-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare nearness or resemblance → settled, felt intimacy

boon.oewn-00454053-s.tone: Warm and a little grand - closeness with good cheer inside it, heartier than the merely matey *chummy*.

chummy.oewn-00454147-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare nearness or resemblance → settled, felt intimacy

chummy.oewn-00454147-s.tone: Informal and light - friendly association on easy terms, without the depth *intimate* claims.

buddy-buddy.oewn-00454147-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare nearness or resemblance → settled, felt intimacy

buddy-buddy.oewn-00454147-s.tone: The doubled informal form makes the closeness emphatic and knowing where *chummy* keeps it mild.

thick.oewn-00454147-s.label: neutral

family.axis: bare nearness or resemblance → settled, felt intimacy

thick.oewn-00454147-s.tone: Blunt informal shorthand for being closely associated, reporting the tie without the warmth *chummy* supplies.

close-knit.oewn-00454440-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare nearness or resemblance → settled, felt intimacy

close-knit.oewn-00454440-s.tone: Approving of cohesion - the bond is what holds people together, structural where *dear* is personal.

closely_knit.oewn-00454440-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare nearness or resemblance → settled, felt intimacy

closely_knit.oewn-00454440-s.tone: The open form spells the binding out and reads more deliberate and descriptive than the compact *close-knit*.

confidential.oewn-00454638-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare nearness or resemblance → settled, felt intimacy

confidential.oewn-00454638-s.tone: Closeness figured as trust - what passes inside it is entrusted, where *chummy* is merely companionable.

cozy.oewn-00454806-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare nearness or resemblance → settled, felt intimacy

cozy.oewn-00454806-s.tone: Insinuating - the closeness is treated as connivance, so the snugness of the word becomes the accusation.

cosy.oewn-00454806-s.label: negative

family.axis: bare nearness or resemblance → settled, felt intimacy

cosy.oewn-00454806-s.tone: The British spelling carrying the same imputation of connivance, warmth named in order to be distrusted.

dear.oewn-00454916-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare nearness or resemblance → settled, felt intimacy

dear.oewn-00454916-s.tone: Affectionate and avowed - the close relationship is felt as fondness, where *thick* merely reports the association.

dear.oewn-00936868-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plainly high in price → priced past what it was worth paying

dear.oewn-00936868-s.tone: British, and softer than *costly* — the same high price delivered in an everyday, conversational word.

dear.oewn-01465246-s.label: positive

family.axis: quietly held dear → loved with the rapture owed a god

dear.oewn-01465246-s.tone: The quiet, unemphatic way to say dearly loved - small in sound and large in meaning.

familiar.oewn-00455086-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare nearness or resemblance → settled, felt intimacy

familiar.oewn-00455086-s.tone: Closeness worn as ease - an established friendship that needs no ceremony, less ardent than *intimate*.

intimate.oewn-00455086-s.label: positive

family.axis: bare nearness or resemblance → settled, felt intimacy

intimate.oewn-00455086-s.tone: The strongest claim in the set - mutual affection and settled friendship, closer and more private than *familiar*.

nonexistent.oewn-00930819-a.label: neutral

family.axis: a bare statement that something is not there → total emptiness, or existence ended altogether

nonexistent.oewn-00930819-a.tone: Flat and absolute - the thing simply has no being, without the sense in *missing* that it was expected somewhere.

lacking.oewn-00931073-s.label: negative

family.axis: a bare statement that something is not there → total emptiness, or existence ended altogether

lacking.oewn-00931073-s.tone: Registers the nonexistence as a deficiency rather than a bare fact, which *absent* does not.

absent.oewn-00931073-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a bare statement that something is not there → total emptiness, or existence ended altogether

absent.oewn-00931073-s.tone: Neutral and faintly formal, stating the nonexistence with none of the note of shortfall in *lacking*.

missing.oewn-00931073-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a bare statement that something is not there → total emptiness, or existence ended altogether

missing.oewn-00931073-s.tone: Points at the gap - the nonexistence is felt as a hole where something belonged.

wanting.oewn-00931073-s.label: negative

family.axis: a bare statement that something is not there → total emptiness, or existence ended altogether

wanting.oewn-00931073-s.tone: The most judging of these - the nonexistence reads as falling short of a mark, not merely as nothing being there.

barren.oewn-00931219-s.label: negative

family.axis: a bare statement that something is not there → total emptiness, or existence ended altogether

barren.oewn-00931219-s.tone: Bleak - the total lack is a desolate condition rather than the cool fact *devoid* states.

destitute.oewn-00931219-s.label: negative

family.axis: a bare statement that something is not there → total emptiness, or existence ended altogether

destitute.oewn-00931219-s.tone: Severe - the complete lack sounds like deprivation, emptiness that hurts.

devoid.oewn-00931219-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a bare statement that something is not there → total emptiness, or existence ended altogether

devoid.oewn-00931219-s.tone: Formal and absolute, naming total emptiness while passing no verdict on it.

free.oewn-00931219-s.label: positive

family.axis: a bare statement that something is not there → total emptiness, or existence ended altogether

free.oewn-00931219-s.tone: The approving member - the same complete lack is a relief, the absent thing one you are better off without.

innocent.oewn-00931219-s.label: positive

family.axis: a bare statement that something is not there → total emptiness, or existence ended altogether

innocent.oewn-00931219-s.tone: Light and wry - complete absence made to sound blameless, the opposite colouring to *destitute*.

nonextant.oewn-00931479-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a bare statement that something is not there → total emptiness, or existence ended altogether

nonextant.oewn-00931479-s.tone: Technical and dry - marks the thing as gone through loss or destruction and judges nothing about it.

vanished.oewn-00931655-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a bare statement that something is not there → total emptiness, or existence ended altogether

vanished.oewn-00931655-s.tone: Carries the drama of a disappearance - existence not merely denied but ended, where *nonexistent* implies no before.

obvious.oewn-01622205-a.label: neutral

family.axis: easy to see → so complete it needs no proof or explanation

obvious.oewn-01622205-a.tone: The flat baseline of the group: a thing takes no effort to see or grasp, without *palpable*'s pressure or *axiomatic*'s claim about proof.

apparent.oewn-01622528-s.label: neutral

family.axis: easy to see → so complete it needs no proof or explanation

apparent.oewn-01622528-s.tone: The lightest way here of saying the thing shows itself — it reports the showing rather than pressing it, unlike *unmistakable*.

evident.oewn-01622528-s.label: neutral

family.axis: easy to see → so complete it needs no proof or explanation

evident.oewn-01622528-s.tone: Plain and unemphatic: the thing is simply there to be seen, with none of the display *manifest* makes of it.

manifest.oewn-01622528-s.label: neutral

family.axis: easy to see → so complete it needs no proof or explanation

manifest.oewn-01622528-s.tone: Formal and expansive — the thing does not merely show but puts itself on show, a grander word than *evident* for the same clarity.

palpable.oewn-01622528-s.label: neutral

family.axis: easy to see → so complete it needs no proof or explanation

palpable.oewn-01622528-s.tone: Pushes the showing towards touch, so the thing is felt as much as seen — heavier in the hand than *apparent*.

patent.oewn-01622528-s.label: neutral

family.axis: easy to see → so complete it needs no proof or explanation

patent.oewn-01622528-s.tone: Formal and declarative: the clarity is stated as settled fact rather than offered as an impression, where *palpable* appeals to the senses.

plain.oewn-01622528-s.label: neutral

family.axis: easy to see → so complete it needs no proof or explanation

plain.oewn-01622528-s.tone: The homeliest word here — clarity with no ceremony at all, exactly what *manifest* supplies in excess.

unmistakable.oewn-01622528-s.label: neutral

family.axis: easy to see → so complete it needs no proof or explanation

unmistakable.oewn-01622528-s.tone: Works by ruling out the alternative: the thing cannot be read as anything else, a firmer guarantee than *apparent* gives.

axiomatic.oewn-01623076-s.label: neutral

family.axis: easy to see → so complete it needs no proof or explanation

axiomatic.oewn-01623076-s.tone: Formal and absolute — the thing stands with no argument put behind it, a larger claim than being merely *evident*.

self-evident.oewn-01623076-s.label: neutral

family.axis: easy to see → so complete it needs no proof or explanation

self-evident.oewn-01623076-s.tone: The plainer word for the same standing as *axiomatic*: the thing carries its own warrant and asks for none to be brought.

taken_for_granted.oewn-01623076-s.label: neutral

family.axis: easy to see → so complete it needs no proof or explanation

taken_for_granted.oewn-01623076-s.tone: An ordinary-language phrase that concedes the standing rather than asserting it — the thing passes without argument instead of being shown to need none.

demonstrable.oewn-01623286-s.label: neutral

family.axis: easy to see → so complete it needs no proof or explanation

demonstrable.oewn-01623286-s.tone: Shifts from what is seen to what can be shown: the clarity is available on demand rather than immediate, unlike *obvious*.

provable.oewn-01623286-s.label: neutral

family.axis: easy to see → so complete it needs no proof or explanation

provable.oewn-01623286-s.tone: The blunter twin of *demonstrable*, resting the whole claim on proof being possible.

frank.oewn-01623560-s.label: neutral

family.axis: easy to see → so complete it needs no proof or explanation

frank.oewn-01623560-s.tone: Technical and unemphatic — it flags the thing as clearly there and does nothing more with it, where *manifest* makes a display.

open-and-shut.oewn-01623656-s.label: neutral

family.axis: easy to see → so complete it needs no proof or explanation

open-and-shut.oewn-01623656-s.tone: Informal and conclusive: the obviousness is enough to settle the matter, not merely to be seen — a force *plain* never reaches.

self-explanatory.oewn-01623785-s.label: neutral

family.axis: easy to see → so complete it needs no proof or explanation

self-explanatory.oewn-01623785-s.tone: The thing supplies its own account, so nothing need be added to it — a different job from *obvious*, which only says it is easy to grasp.

expensive.oewn-00936423-a.label: neutral

family.axis: plainly high in price → priced past what it was worth paying

expensive.oewn-00936423-a.tone: The plain word for a high price, stating the fact without deciding whether the price is deserved.

big-ticket.oewn-00936684-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plainly high in price → priced past what it was worth paying

big-ticket.oewn-00936684-s.tone: Steps up from *expensive* to a price high enough to be remarkable, still with no verdict attached to it.

high-ticket.oewn-00936684-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plainly high in price → priced past what it was worth paying

high-ticket.oewn-00936684-s.tone: Carries the same very-high price as *big-ticket* in a flatter, more transactional ring.

costly.oewn-00936868-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plainly high in price → priced past what it was worth paying

costly.oewn-00936868-s.tone: Weightier than *high-priced*, the price felt as a cost borne rather than a number quoted.

high-priced.oewn-00936868-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plainly high in price → priced past what it was worth paying

high-priced.oewn-00936868-s.tone: Flat and purely descriptive: it says the price is high and refuses any attitude toward it.

pricey.oewn-00936868-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly high in price → priced past what it was worth paying

pricey.oewn-00936868-s.tone: Informal and faintly grumbling — the high price registered as a small complaint rather than a measurement.

pricy.oewn-00936868-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly high in price → priced past what it was worth paying

pricy.oewn-00936868-s.tone: The same informal grumble as *pricey* in a clipped spelling, with no shift in force.

dearly-won.oewn-00937210-s.label: neutral

family.axis: plainly high in price → priced past what it was worth paying

dearly-won.oewn-00937210-s.tone: Moves the price off money entirely onto loss or sacrifice, naming what something took without condemning it.

overpriced.oewn-00937351-s.label: negative

family.axis: plainly high in price → priced past what it was worth paying

overpriced.oewn-00937351-s.tone: Judgement rather than measurement — it sets the price against the value and finds it unearned.

loved.oewn-01464744-a.label: positive

family.axis: quietly held dear → loved with the rapture owed a god

loved.oewn-01464744-a.tone: The plain word for holding dear, stating the fact of the feeling without measuring its heat, where *adored* measures nothing else.

admired.oewn-01464968-s.label: positive

family.axis: quietly held dear → loved with the rapture owed a god

admired.oewn-01464968-s.tone: Regard rather than warmth - the approval answers to what the object is, so it can be offered coolly and from a distance.

adored.oewn-01465046-s.label: positive

family.axis: quietly held dear → loved with the rapture owed a god

adored.oewn-01465046-s.tone: Love at its most rapturous, pitched as high as devotion to a god and far past anything *loved* claims.

idolized.oewn-01465046-s.label: positive

family.axis: quietly held dear → loved with the rapture owed a god

idolized.oewn-01465046-s.tone: Sets the loved one above the lover - rapture that looks up at what it loves.

idolised.oewn-01465046-s.label: positive

family.axis: quietly held dear → loved with the rapture owed a god

idolised.oewn-01465046-s.tone: The same raising of the loved one into an object of worship, love felt as reverence rather than as fondness.

worshipped.oewn-01465046-s.label: positive

family.axis: quietly held dear → loved with the rapture owed a god

worshipped.oewn-01465046-s.tone: States outright the comparison the others only lean on: love offered as if to a god.

beloved.oewn-01465246-s.label: positive

family.axis: quietly held dear → loved with the rapture owed a god

beloved.oewn-01465246-s.tone: Formal and settled - it names the one dearly loved instead of reporting a feeling, which gives it a weight *darling* has none of.

darling.oewn-01465246-s.label: positive

family.axis: quietly held dear → loved with the rapture owed a god

darling.oewn-01465246-s.tone: Fond and light, dear love spoken as endearment; it can be said playfully where *beloved* cannot.

blue-eyed.oewn-01465383-s.label: positive

family.axis: quietly held dear → loved with the rapture owed a god

blue-eyed.oewn-01465383-s.tone: Names the favorite by an image rather than by any word for feeling, so the approval reads as preference rather than passion.

fair-haired.oewn-01465383-s.label: positive

family.axis: quietly held dear → loved with the rapture owed a god

fair-haired.oewn-01465383-s.tone: Marks the one singled out for favor - flattering about standing, not about the depth of love in *adored*.

white-haired.oewn-01465383-s.label: positive

family.axis: quietly held dear → loved with the rapture owed a god

white-haired.oewn-01465383-s.tone: A figurative way of calling someone the favorite: approval that consists in being picked out.

cherished.oewn-01465547-s.label: positive

family.axis: quietly held dear → loved with the rapture owed a god

cherished.oewn-01465547-s.tone: Fond affection with tending in it - the feeling is kept up, not merely felt.

precious.oewn-01465547-s.label: positive

family.axis: quietly held dear → loved with the rapture owed a god

precious.oewn-01465547-s.tone: Turns fond affection into worth, so the one held is valued as much as loved.

treasured.oewn-01465547-s.label: positive

family.axis: quietly held dear → loved with the rapture owed a god

treasured.oewn-01465547-s.tone: Affection that hoards - what is felt fondly is also kept and guarded, where *cherished* only tends it.

wanted.oewn-01465547-s.label: positive

family.axis: quietly held dear → loved with the rapture owed a god

wanted.oewn-01465547-s.tone: The plainest of these - fond affection showing itself as desire for the one held, with none of the ceremony of *treasured*.

pleasing.oewn-01812521-a.label: positive

family.axis: faint, matter-of-fact approval → superlative delight

pleasing.oewn-01812521-a.tone: Plain, unraised approval - it states the pleasure and satisfaction given and leaves it there, where *delightful* insists.

admirable.oewn-01812870-s.label: positive

family.axis: faint, matter-of-fact approval → superlative delight

admirable.oewn-01812870-s.tone: Approval with esteem in it - it asks you to look up at the thing rather than merely enjoy it, a graver register than *charming*.

charming.oewn-01813064-s.label: positive

family.axis: faint, matter-of-fact approval → superlative delight

charming.oewn-01813064-s.tone: Warm and disarming - the pleasure sounds like an appeal exerted on you, gentler than *delightful*'s enthusiasm.

delightful.oewn-01813229-s.label: positive

family.axis: faint, matter-of-fact approval → superlative delight

delightful.oewn-01813229-s.tone: Enthusiastic - the pleasure is raised to a high pitch and given an edge of entertainment that *pleasing* lacks.

delicious.oewn-01813229-s.label: positive

family.axis: faint, matter-of-fact approval → superlative delight

delicious.oewn-01813229-s.tone: Savouring - it makes high pleasure sound like something relished, richer and more indulgent than *delightful*.

easy.oewn-01813404-s.label: positive

family.axis: faint, matter-of-fact approval → superlative delight

easy.oewn-01813404-s.tone: Understated to the edge of neutrality - it concedes that pleasure is afforded without any warmth of praise behind it.

fabulous.oewn-01813492-s.label: positive

family.axis: faint, matter-of-fact approval → superlative delight

fabulous.oewn-01813492-s.tone: Extravagant - praise pitched at the ceiling and past plausibility, far louder than *pleasing*.

fab.oewn-01813492-s.label: positive

family.axis: faint, matter-of-fact approval → superlative delight

fab.oewn-01813492-s.tone: Slangy and clipped - the same top-of-the-scale praise as *fabulous*, tossed off rather than declared.

gratifying.oewn-01813678-s.label: positive

family.axis: faint, matter-of-fact approval → superlative delight

gratifying.oewn-01813678-s.tone: Sober and faintly formal - it puts the pleasure in the mind or the feelings rather than on the surface, weightier than *sweet*.

sweet.oewn-01813678-s.label: positive

family.axis: faint, matter-of-fact approval → superlative delight

sweet.oewn-01813678-s.tone: Warm and informal - the same inward pleasure as *gratifying*, but tender and unguarded rather than composed.

ingratiating.oewn-01813809-s.label: neutral

family.axis: faint, matter-of-fact approval → superlative delight

ingratiating.oewn-01813809-s.tone: It measures pleasing by the favour won rather than by the pleasure given, which tilts it away from praising the thing at all, unlike *charming*.

difficult.oewn-00748528-a.label: neutral

family.axis: difficulty framed as a stretch worth making → difficulty framed as a predicament no one would want

difficult.oewn-00748528-a.tone: Flat and unemotive - it registers that effort is required to do, grasp or bear the thing, without hinting whether that effort is worth spending, as *challenging* does.

hard.oewn-00748528-a.label: neutral

family.axis: difficulty framed as a stretch worth making → difficulty framed as a predicament no one would want

hard.oewn-00748528-a.tone: The blunt, plain-spoken version of *difficult* for the same demand, taking effort of body, mind or endurance as it comes and softening none of it.

ambitious.oewn-00749254-s.label: positive

family.axis: difficulty framed as a stretch worth making → difficulty framed as a predicament no one would want

ambitious.oewn-00749254-s.tone: Approving - it treats the full call on your abilities and resources as a reach worth making rather than a weight to be borne.

challenging.oewn-00749254-s.label: positive

family.axis: difficulty framed as a stretch worth making → difficulty framed as a predicament no one would want

challenging.oewn-00749254-s.tone: Turns that same full call on everything you have into an invitation to rise to it, so the demand reads as a spur where *problematic* reads as a fault.

arduous.oewn-00749470-s.label: neutral

family.axis: difficulty framed as a stretch worth making → difficulty framed as a predicament no one would want

arduous.oewn-00749470-s.tone: Formal and weighty - it dwells on the sustained mental effort and skill the thing exacts before it will be accomplished, heavier in the mouth than *hard*.

awkward.oewn-00749659-s.label: negative

family.axis: difficulty framed as a stretch worth making → difficulty framed as a predicament no one would want

awkward.oewn-00749659-s.tone: Mildly disapproving - the difficulty sits in the handling, since any move you make risks the pain or embarrassment the thing carries.

embarrassing.oewn-00749659-s.label: negative

family.axis: difficulty framed as a stretch worth making → difficulty framed as a predicament no one would want

embarrassing.oewn-00749659-s.tone: Puts the discomfort squarely on the face of whoever has to deal with it, naming the exposure that *awkward* leaves implied.

sticky.oewn-00749659-s.label: negative

family.axis: difficulty framed as a stretch worth making → difficulty framed as a predicament no one would want

sticky.oewn-00749659-s.tone: Informal - it makes the trouble something you are caught in and cannot step cleanly out of, lighter in tone than *unenviable* and no easier to escape.

unenviable.oewn-00749659-s.label: negative

family.axis: difficulty framed as a stretch worth making → difficulty framed as a predicament no one would want

unenviable.oewn-00749659-s.tone: An understated verdict that condemns by observation - the thing is framed as unwished-for, and the word damns it without raising its voice.

baffling.oewn-00750063-s.label: neutral

family.axis: difficulty framed as a stretch worth making → difficulty framed as a predicament no one would want

baffling.oewn-00750063-s.tone: Puts the great mental demand where understanding fails - the thing does not merely resist solution, it leaves you at a loss.

elusive.oewn-00750063-s.label: neutral

family.axis: difficulty framed as a stretch worth making → difficulty framed as a predicament no one would want

elusive.oewn-00750063-s.tone: The difficulty is in the slipping away: comprehension seems within reach and will not close on it, unlike the frank obstruction of *knotty*.

knotty.oewn-00750063-s.label: neutral

family.axis: difficulty framed as a stretch worth making → difficulty framed as a predicament no one would want

knotty.oewn-00750063-s.tone: Gives the mental demand a shape - a tangle to be picked apart strand by strand, rather than the blank wall of *baffling*.

problematic.oewn-00750063-s.label: negative

family.axis: difficulty framed as a stretch worth making → difficulty framed as a predicament no one would want

problematic.oewn-00750063-s.tone: Labels the demanding thing a problem outright, a mild verdict against it where *tough* only reports the demand.

problematical.oewn-00750063-s.label: negative

family.axis: difficulty framed as a stretch worth making → difficulty framed as a predicament no one would want

problematical.oewn-00750063-s.tone: Stiffer and more formal than *problematic* for the same verdict, its extra syllable adding weight rather than force.

catchy.oewn-00750431-s.label: negative

family.axis: difficulty framed as a stretch worth making → difficulty framed as a predicament no one would want

catchy.oewn-00750431-s.tone: Warns of a snare - the difficulty is concealed until you are into it, so the word marks the thing as harder than it lets on.

demanding.oewn-00713705-a.label: neutral

family.axis: requiring more than usual → severe and impossible to satisfy

demanding.oewn-00713705-a.tone: Plain and unheated - it names the size of what is asked without ruling on whether asking it is fair, where *hard-to-please* has already convicted someone.

exigent.oewn-00714030-s.label: neutral

family.axis: requiring more than usual → severe and impossible to satisfy

exigent.oewn-00714030-s.tone: The formal, cool-surfaced twin of *exacting* - the same insistence on precision, pitched at a distance.

exacting.oewn-00714030-s.label: neutral

family.axis: requiring more than usual → severe and impossible to satisfy

exacting.oewn-00714030-s.tone: Puts the weight on the standard itself, so the precision reads as a measure to be met rather than a temper to be humoured.

hard-to-please.oewn-00714186-s.label: negative

family.axis: requiring more than usual → severe and impossible to satisfy

hard-to-please.oewn-00714186-s.tone: Disparaging - the fussiness makes the demand a flaw in the person, which *exacting* never does.

hard_to_please.oewn-00714186-s.label: negative

family.axis: requiring more than usual → severe and impossible to satisfy

hard_to_please.oewn-00714186-s.tone: The open spelling carries the same verdict but reads as a running remark about someone rather than a label fixed to them.

needy.oewn-00714375-s.label: negative

family.axis: requiring more than usual → severe and impossible to satisfy

needy.oewn-00714375-s.tone: Belittling and intimate - the excess is emotional appetite, and the word tips toward pity where *hard-to-please* stays at irritation.

rigorous.oewn-00714525-s.label: positive

family.axis: requiring more than usual → severe and impossible to satisfy

rigorous.oewn-00714525-s.tone: Approving - the strictness registers as discipline worth having, where *tight* only pinches.

stringent.oewn-00714525-s.label: neutral

family.axis: requiring more than usual → severe and impossible to satisfy

stringent.oewn-00714525-s.tone: Cool and administrative, stating how tightly the rules bind without either praising or resenting the binding.

tight.oewn-00714525-s.label: negative

family.axis: requiring more than usual → severe and impossible to satisfy

tight.oewn-00714525-s.tone: The informal one, and the constriction is felt - the rules squeeze rather than uphold anything.

stern.oewn-00714774-s.label: negative

family.axis: requiring more than usual → severe and impossible to satisfy

stern.oewn-00714774-s.tone: Adds a forbidding manner to the severity - the unrelenting demand arrives with a chill that *strict* does not carry.

strict.oewn-00714774-s.label: neutral

family.axis: requiring more than usual → severe and impossible to satisfy

strict.oewn-00714774-s.tone: The flat word for the same unrelenting severity, stating it without colouring it as harshness.

inclined.oewn-01295251-a.label: neutral

family.axis: a light leaning that could go either way → a tendency fixed hard enough to be counted on

inclined.oewn-01295251-a.tone: Mild and non-committal - the leaning is stated lightly enough to leave room for doing otherwise, where *prone* fixes it in place.

apt.oewn-01295534-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a light leaning that could go either way → a tendency fixed hard enough to be counted on

apt.oewn-01295534-s.tone: Neutral but predictive - it treats the leaning as a matter of the subject's nature, so what follows sounds expected rather than merely possible.

disposed.oewn-01295534-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a light leaning that could go either way → a tendency fixed hard enough to be counted on

disposed.oewn-01295534-s.tone: Formal and dry - the leaning sounds like a settled arrangement of temperament rather than an appetite, cooler than *given*.

given.oewn-01295534-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a light leaning that could go either way → a tendency fixed hard enough to be counted on

given.oewn-01295534-s.tone: Blunt and settled - the disposition sounds ingrained rather than merely present, heavier and more everyday than *disposed*.

minded.oewn-01295534-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a light leaning that could go either way → a tendency fixed hard enough to be counted on

minded.oewn-01295534-s.tone: Puts the disposition in the subject's cast of mind rather than in what it does, which is what separates it from *tending*.

tending.oewn-01295534-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a light leaning that could go either way → a tendency fixed hard enough to be counted on

tending.oewn-01295534-s.tone: The plainest of these - it names the direction of the leaning and claims nothing about temperament or liking.

fond.oewn-01295806-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a light leaning that could go either way → a tendency fixed hard enough to be counted on

fond.oewn-01295806-s.tone: Warm - the leaning is felt as liking rather than as mere direction, which is what lifts it clear of *inclined*.

partial.oewn-01295806-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a light leaning that could go either way → a tendency fixed hard enough to be counted on

partial.oewn-01295806-s.tone: Lighter and more indulgent than *fond* - it casts the strong liking as a weakness cheerfully admitted.

prone.oewn-01296007-s.label: neutral

family.axis: a light leaning that could go either way → a tendency fixed hard enough to be counted on

prone.oewn-01296007-s.tone: Flat and fixing - it states the tendency as a standing liability rather than a leaning, and welds straight onto whatever is tended toward.

accident-prone.oewn-01296172-s.label: negative

family.axis: a light leaning that could go either way → a tendency fixed hard enough to be counted on

accident-prone.oewn-01296172-s.tone: Mildly damning - it turns a count of mishaps into a standing property of whatever it is aimed at, so the accidents read as owed to it rather than to chance.

advantageous.oewn-00064738-a.label: positive

family.axis: advantage merely registered → good actively credited

advantageous.oewn-00064738-a.tone: Cool, calculating approval — it rates a thing by the edge it hands you and says nothing about whether that edge is deserved or does any good.

favorable.oewn-00064738-a.label: positive

family.axis: advantage merely registered → good actively credited

favorable.oewn-00064738-a.tone: Warmer than *advantageous*: the advantage reads as conditions tilting your way rather than as an edge coldly reckoned up.

favourable.oewn-00064738-a.label: positive

family.axis: advantage merely registered → good actively credited

favourable.oewn-00064738-a.tone: The British spelling of *favorable*, carrying the identical tilt-in-your-favour approval with no shift in force.

beneficial.oewn-00065107-s.label: positive

family.axis: advantage merely registered → good actively credited

beneficial.oewn-00065107-s.tone: Formal and firmly approving — it credits the thing with actually improving matters, where *advantageous* only counts the edge gained.

plus.oewn-00065384-s.label: positive

family.axis: advantage merely registered → good actively credited

plus.oewn-00065384-s.tone: Brisk and informal — it books a thing on the credit side without pausing to weigh how much good is in it.

discriminatory.oewn-00065504-s.label: negative

family.axis: advantage merely registered → good actively credited

discriminatory.oewn-00065504-s.tone: Accusatory where its neighbours approve — it treats the partiality itself as the offence rather than as a favour worth having.

preferential.oewn-00065504-s.label: neutral

family.axis: advantage merely registered → good actively credited

preferential.oewn-00065504-s.tone: Flat and administrative: it records that partiality is in play and leaves untouched the question *discriminatory* settles against it.

desirable.oewn-00736491-a.label: positive

family.axis: mildly preferable → hotly craved

desirable.oewn-00736491-a.tone: The measured, unheated verdict — it says a thing is worth having without claiming anyone is straining after it, which is what *coveted* adds.

coveted.oewn-00736828-s.label: positive

family.axis: mildly preferable → hotly craved

coveted.oewn-00736828-s.tone: Loads the wanting with hunger, so the thing is not merely worth having but longed for hard, far greedier than the flat *in demand*.

in_demand.oewn-00736828-s.label: positive

family.axis: mildly preferable → hotly craved

in_demand.oewn-00736828-s.tone: States much-wantedness as a plain fact about a thing's standing, with none of the appetite audible in *coveted*.

sought_after.oewn-00736828-s.label: positive

family.axis: mildly preferable → hotly craved

sought_after.oewn-00736828-s.tone: Puts the wanting into motion — the thing is actively pursued, where *in demand* leaves it a standing condition.

sought-after.oewn-00736828-s.label: positive

family.axis: mildly preferable → hotly craved

sought-after.oewn-00736828-s.tone: The hyphen compresses that same pursuit into a single modifier that can sit in front of the noun it flatters.

delectable.oewn-00736942-s.label: positive

family.axis: mildly preferable → hotly craved

delectable.oewn-00736942-s.tone: Relishing rather than clinical, it savours the desire the thing arouses where *sexually attractive* merely reports it.

sexually_attractive.oewn-00736942-s.label: positive

family.axis: mildly preferable → hotly craved

sexually_attractive.oewn-00736942-s.tone: Flat and explicit, naming the arousal outright without a trace of the relish in *delectable*.

enviable.oewn-00737084-s.label: positive

family.axis: mildly preferable → hotly craved

enviable.oewn-00737084-s.tone: Praises a thing by pointing at the sourness it stirs in whoever lacks it, so the approval arrives through someone else's discontent.

plummy.oewn-00737175-s.label: positive

family.axis: mildly preferable → hotly craved

plummy.oewn-00737175-s.tone: Informal and relishing, it heaps the desirability higher than the sober *desirable* and sounds pleased with itself for saying so.

preferable.oewn-00737286-s.label: positive

family.axis: mildly preferable → hotly craved

preferable.oewn-00737286-s.tone: A comparative and nothing more — it rates one thing above another without claiming either is wanted much at all.

preferred.oewn-00737286-s.label: positive

family.axis: mildly preferable → hotly craved

preferred.oewn-00737286-s.tone: Settles the comparison that *preferable* is still arguing, presenting the ranking as already decided rather than urged.
